findings: `learner.overview.text` says the graph “is an old graph interpreted as a shield,” but omits the essential borrowing explanation for the common dry and trunk readings. Explain that in simplified Chinese 干 is used to write the separate words traditionally written 乾 and 幹; the shield picture’s old name and its sound relation to those words are not established here, so do not imply a proven phonetic loan. Cite the spelling evidence and the limitation.
